title: Fraud Investigation & Incident Escalation Procedure
content: Fraud Investigation Protocol: When a transaction is flagged with a Risk Score of 70 or above, an automated investigation ticket is generated. The Risk Analyst must inspect the customer's prior 90-day spending history, merchant geolocation, and device fingerprints. If evidence indicates credential stuffing or account takeover, a simulated account freeze request must be submitted through the Approval Center. Actions affecting customer funds or account access require documented manager sign-off with an audit log record.

passages.text: Escalation guidelines: Transactions with Risk Score >= 70 require immediate analyst review. If unauthorized access is suspected, the analyst creates an Approval Request to freeze the account.
Auditing requirements: All investigative steps, agent tool executions, and approval decisions must be permanently written to the immutable audit trail with correlation IDs.
